    {time:0,    head:[0,0,0,1],      left:[71,93,0,1,1,1,0],          right:[212,82,0,1,1,1,0]},

    {time:500,  head:[0,10,9,1],     left:[25,114,-13,.93,.83,.86,5], right:[187,126,-21,1.17,.88,1.03,0]},
    {time:680,  head:[1,5,9,1],      left:[23,106,-21,.90,.83,.84,5], right:[176,111,-26,1.24,.96,1.04,7]},
    {time:840,  head:[0,2,0,1.01],   left:[63,96,-4,1,1,1,3],        right:[211,94,0,1,.97,1,0]},
    {time:1020, head:[1,5,11,1],     left:[20,95,-21,.94,.84,.75,8],  right:[171,115,-23,1.24,.97,1.04,8]},
    {time:1180, head:[2,10,2,1.02],  left:[46,118,-9,.92,.91,1,0],    right:[207,113,-9,1.06,.94,1.08,1]}
  ];
  poses.push({...poses[0], time:1200});

  function placeWing(arm, hand, originX, originY, pose) {
    const [x, y, angle, width, height, tipWidth, tipAngle] = pose;
    arm.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${width} ${height}) translate(${-originX} ${-originY})`);
    hand.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${originX} ${originY}) rotate(${tipAngle}) scale(${tipWidth} 1) translate(${-originX} ${-originY})`);
  }

  window.nwb = {
    render(t) {
      const time = ((t % 1200) + 1200) % 1200;
      let index = 0;
      while (time >= poses[index + 1].time) index++;
      const from = poses[index];
      const to = poses[index + 1];
      const progress = (time - from.time) / (to.time - from.time);
      const weight = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
      const blend = (start, end) => start.map((value, i) => value + (end[i] - value) * weight);

      const [shiftX, drop, tilt, breadth] = blend(from.head, to.head);
      const height = 1 - drop / 242;
      body.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(125 242) matrix(${breadth} 0 ${-shiftX / 242} ${height} 0 0) translate(-125 -242)`);
      head.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(${shiftX} ${drop}) rotate(${tilt} 124 24)`);

      placeWing(left, leftHand, 71, 93, blend(from.left, to.left));
      placeWing(right, rightHand, 212, 82, blend(from.right, to.right));
    }
  };
  window.nwb.render(0);
})();

        <path d="M211 66c-2 7-3 14-8 20 7-1 10-6 13-12Z" fill="#817150" opacity=".53"/>
        <path d="M202 93c6-1 13-6 18-8" fill="none" stroke="#9c8052" stroke-width="2.6" opacity=".48"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <rect id="frame-texture" width="244" height="240" fill="url(#fine-grain)" opacity=".35" pointer-events="none"/>
</svg>
<script>
(() => {
  const body = document.getElementById("body");
  const head = document.getElementById("head");
  const left = document.getElementById("arm-screen-left");
  const right = document.getElementById("arm-screen-right");
  const leftHand = document.getElementById("hand-screen-left");
  const rightHand = document.getElementById("hand-screen-right");

  // Wings are positioned by the center of the dark tip. The final two
  // parameters adjust the tip independently of the rest of the wing.
  const poses = [
    {time:0,    head:[0,0,0,1],      left:[71,93,0,1,1,1,0],          right:[212,82,0,1,1,1,0]},
    {time:160,  head:[1,1,12,1],     left:[18,76,-21,.96,.92,.73,9],  right:[157,99,-30,1.31,.99,.94,14]},
    {time:340,  head:[2,4,2,1.01],   left:[59,106,-6,.93,1,1,3],      right:[211,94,-3,1,.97,1,0]},
    {time:500,  head:[0,10,9,1],     left:[25,114,-13,.93,.83,.86,5], right:[187,126,-21,1.17,.88,1.03,0]},
    {time:680,  head:[1,5,9,1],      left:[23,106,-21,.90,.83,.84,5], right:[176,111,-26,1.24,.96,1.04,7]},
    {time:840,  head:[0,2,0,1.01],   left:[63,96,-4,1,1,1,3],        right:[211,94,0,1,.97,1,0]},
    {time:1020, head:[1,5,11,1],     left:[20,95,-21,.94,.84,.75,8],  right:[171,115,-23,1.24,.97,1.04,8]},
    {time:1180, head:[2,10,2,1.02],  left:[46,118,-9,.92,.91,1,0],    right:[207,113,-9,1.06,.94,1.08,1]}
  ];
  poses.push({...poses[0], time:1200});

  function placeWing(arm, hand, originX, originY, pose) {
    const [x, y, angle, width, height, tipWidth, tipAngle] = pose;
    arm.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${x} ${y}) rotate(${angle}) scale(${width} ${height}) translate(${-originX} ${-originY})`);
    hand.setAttribute("transform",
      `translate(${originX} ${originY}) rotate(${tipAngle}) scale(${tipWidth} 1) translate(${-originX} ${-originY})`);
  }

  window.nwb = {
    render(t) {
      const time = ((t % 1200) + 1200) % 1200;
      let index = 0;
      while (time >= poses[index + 1].time) index++;
      const from = poses[index];
      const to = poses[index + 1];
      const progress = (time - from.time) / (to.time - from.time);
      const weight = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
      const blend = (start, end) => start.map((value, i) => value + (end[i] - value) * weight);

      const [shiftX, drop, tilt, breadth] = blend(from.head, to.head);
      const height = 1 - drop / 242;
      body.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(125 242) matrix(${breadth} 0 ${-shiftX / 242} ${height} 0 0) translate(-125 -242)`);
      head.setAttribute("transform",
        `translate(${shiftX} ${drop}) rotate(${tilt} 124 24)`);

      placeWing(left, leftHand, 71, 93, blend(from.left, to.left));
      placeWing(right, rightHand, 212, 82, blend(from.right, to.right));
    }
  };
  window.nwb.render(0);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
